columns_never_fillable.reason: CLAS does not disclose NPI. 'Gross profit' (gross revenue minus direct expenses) plays NPI's role. The Statement of Total Return (p.114), Note 22/23 (p.213-214), and Financial Review (p.18-20) were checked — no NPI line exists. Trap #18: income model change means this structural null, not a disclosure gap.

CLAS does not disclose gross revenue at the individual property level. Per-property revenue breakdown is not published in the annual report; revenue is aggregated at contract-type and country level only. Checked: Financial Review (p.18-20), Portfolio Listing (p.54-59), Portfolio Statements (p.127-144).
Structural null — same as trust-level: NPI not used by CLAS. Gross profit is also only disclosed at trust level (not per property).

For master lease properties (France, Germany, Japan BT hotels, South Korea BT hotels, Singapore BT hotel), occupancy is not a relevant metric as the master tenant guarantees fixed/variable rent regardless of occupancy. For management contract properties, overall portfolio occupancy stats are disclosed (e.g. 82% serviced residences, 88% living sector, p.27) but not per individual property. Checked: Portfolio Listing (p.54-59), property factsheets (not present in this report).

CLAS discloses unit counts (number of units/keys/beds) for hospitality/living sector properties but not GLA/NLA in sqm/sqft. No GLA table found. Checked: Portfolio Listing (p.54-59), Portfolio Statements (p.127-144).
Trade mix is disclosed at the trust level by contract type and country (p.26) but not at individual property level.

For master lease properties, the counterparty is the master lessor (e.g. CapitaLand Ascott Holding Group entities) rather than end-occupiers. For management contract properties, corporate client percentages are at portfolio level (p.27) not per property. No individual property-level tenant list is disclosed. Checked: Portfolio Listing (p.54-59).
CLAS top corporate clients ranked by % of rental income from management contract properties only; NLA percentage not disclosed.

Both FY2025 acquisition bundles (Bundle A: ibis Styles Tokyo Ginza + Chisun Budget Kanazawa Ekimae; Bundle B: Pre de Cort Nishikyogoku + Splendide Namba West + Pregio Esaka South) disclose a single combined price for the bundle. Individual property prices within each bundle are not disclosed.

parsing_traps.trap: Duplicate rows in Management Contracts table (p.19)
parsing_traps.detail: The management contracts table on p.19 contains duplicate rows for Japan, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, and USA. This is a LlamaParse parser artifact (table continuation misread as separate rows). Correct figures reconcile to stated subtotals: Revenue $494.3m, Gross Profit $189.6m. The artifact set produces inflated totals. Selected the reconciling set; artifact documented.
parsing_traps.action: income_components.json uses Note 22/23 (p.213-214) audited totals, not the p.19 table. properties.json gross_revenue and gross_profit are null (not per-property).

parsing_traps.trap: Top 10 Corporate Clients table has 11 rows
parsing_traps.detail: Table titled 'FY 2025 Top 10 Corporate Clients' (p.27) contains 11 rows. The first row is an aggregate 'Government entities and embassies of various countries' (1.2%), followed by 10 named corporate clients. Recorded as-disclosed with ranks 1-11.
parsing_traps.action: top_tenants.json records all 11 rows. Sum of gri_percentage = 2.4% (indicating denominator is management contract rental income only, not trust-level).

parsing_traps.trap: The Robertson House classification — BT PPE vs REIT investment property
parsing_traps.detail: The Robertson House by The Crest Collection ($337,950,000) is classified as 'Leasehold land and buildings' (PPE) under CapitaLand Ascott BT Group, not as 'Investment properties' under REIT Group. In the investment properties section of the Portfolio Statements (p.138), the Stapled Group column shows '–' for this property; the $337,950,000 appears in the REIT Group column. The summary on p.144 shows it correctly in the Stapled Group total. Audited value confirmed: $337,950,000.
parsing_traps.action: properties.json records market_valuation = $337,950,000 with market_valuation_note explaining the BT PPE classification and page references.

parsing_traps.trap: BT Group properties: Stapled Group column only (no REIT Group figure)
parsing_traps.detail: Properties held by CapitaLand Ascott BT Group (Sotetsu Grand Fresa Osaka-Namba; ibis Ambassador Seoul Insadong; Sotetsu Hotels The Splaisir Seoul Dongdaemun; Pullman/Mercure Brisbane, Melbourne, Sydney; Sydney Central Hotel; Temple Bar Hotel Dublin) show valuations only in the Stapled Group column of the Portfolio Statements, with '–' in the REIT Group column. These are not REIT assets. value_basis = 'consolidated' as they are consolidated line-by-line into the Stapled Group.
parsing_traps.action: properties.json market_valuation taken from Stapled Group column with note. value_basis = 'consolidated' for all.

parsing_traps.trap: Trap #18 — CLAS uses 'gross profit' not NPI
parsing_traps.detail: CLAS does not report Net Property Income. 'Gross profit' (gross revenue minus direct expenses) is the primary income metric. Confirmed in all financial statement sections. gross_profit = $385,301,000 (Stapled Group FY2025, p.114). net_property_income = null throughout with structural explanation.

parsing_traps.trap: Portfolio valuation: headline S$7.9bn vs audited S$7,637,513,000
parsing_traps.detail: Headline portfolio valuation = S$7.9 billion (p.21, revaluation result including all proportionate interests). Audited Portfolio Statement Stapled Group total (investment properties + freehold land & buildings, p.143) = $7,637,513,000. Adding Robertson House leasehold land & buildings ($337,950,000, p.144) = $7,975,463,000 ≈ $7.9bn rounded. The headline includes full appraised values; audited B/S total is the book carrying value.
parsing_traps.action: performance.json: portfolio_value = 7900000000 (headline); portfolio_value_alt = 7637513000 (audited Portfolio Statement total). Robertson House included in the ~$7.9bn reconciliation.

parsing_traps.trap: Partial lease expiry dates — only year disclosed
parsing_traps.detail: Portfolio Listing (p.54-59) discloses lease expiry years only (e.g. '2113', '2078', '2044'). No month or day is given. Convention applied: lease_expiry_date = YYYY-01-01 (day 01 of January of the stated year) with note 'only year disclosed in Portfolio Listing'.
parsing_traps.action: All lease_expiry_date fields in properties.json use YYYY-01-01 format with notes.

reconciliation.sum_property_market_valuation_note: Sum of market_valuation across all 103 active/under-development properties in properties.json (Stapled Group audited carrying values, p.127-144). Includes investment properties ($7,637,513,000 from p.143 Stapled Group total) + Robertson House leasehold land & buildings ($337,950,000 from p.144). This equals reported audited total. Divested properties (Somerset Olympic Tower Tianjin + Citadines Central Shinjuku Tokyo) excluded as status = 'divested'.
reconciliation.reported_total_portfolio_value_note: Headline S$7.9 billion (p.21) is the revaluation result including proportionate JV interests. Audited carrying total = $7,975,463,000 before deducting disposal proceeds/timing. The S$38m difference is within rounding at the headline 'S$7.9 billion' level.
reconciliation.fx_rate_note: No single FX rate table disclosed. Implied rates from transaction disclosures: JPY/SGD ~117.6 (Jan 2025 bundle), ~112.3 (Oct 2025 divestment), RMB/SGD ~5.43 (Apr 2025 divestment). These are implied, not official disclosed rates.
